reason_for_version: Replace per-conclusion LM policy calls with one task-level batch review before any valid GLM v3/v4 score was observed.
retained_attempts: credit/run-invalid-trace-selector-attempt-1: invalid because selector exhausted reasoning budget and returned no JSON
credit/run-obsolete-per-item-judge-attempt-2: stopped before receiver/scoring when batch-review mechanism was adopted

policy_transaction.deterministic_checks: run locally and record independently for every proposed conclusion
policy_transaction.batch_judge: one Gemini call receives every conclusion, its evidence bindings, and deterministic result, then returns one independent verdict, rationale, risk level, and shared batch receipt
policy_transaction.individual_re_review: only conclusions marked high risk or escalated receive a separate judge call
policy_transaction.ledger_semantics: each conclusion retains its own judge_recommended and admission or rejection events linked to the batch receipt
policy_transaction.failure_mode: missing, duplicate, unknown, or malformed verdicts fail the entire transaction closed

proof_price_accounting: Count one batch inference plus any high-risk/escalated re-reviews, graph selection, evidence expansion, receiver work, evaluator work, tokens, latency, and provider cost.
